2 وزّأ الوِعَآءَ , inf. n. تَوْزِئَةٌ and تَوْزِىْءٌ, He made tight the contents of the bag; or other repository: syn. شَدَّ كَنْزَهُ. (AZ, S, K.) ―
-b2- وزّأ, (S, K,) inf. n. تَوْزِىْءٌ, (S,) He filled a water-skin (S, K) or other vessel. (TA.) ＝
-A2- وزّأت بِهِ, (S, K,) inf. n. تَوْزِئَةٌ, (S,) She (a mare, TA) or a camel, S, K,) threw him (i. e. her rider, TA,) down prostrate. (S, K.) ＝
-A3- وزّأه He made him bind himself by every oath: (K:) or by a hard, or severe, oath. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
